versions.changelog:
Initial release of Hermes Web Tools skill.

- Provides diagnosis and troubleshooting guidance for Hermes web_search and web_extract backend selection.
- Details strict backend selection logic, valid provider names, error handling, and investigation workflow.
- Emphasizes a read-only, confirmation-first approach—do not make changes without explicit user approval.
- Outlines common pitfalls and root causes for web tool failures, especially configuration or site-specific issues.
